relevance_note: Single case report of a man diagnosed with LAD by reduced CD18 expression without genetic testing: 'Therefore, a diagnosis of mild LAD was made.'; no ITGB2 variant is reported (field name is the schema's legacy name).
method_note: Read by hand; JSON assembled with a short Python script in the scratch directory, every span checked verbatim against the paper. Scope: the patient is in scope only through a clinical/flow-cytometry diagnosis of 'mild LAD' (CD18 82.6% of normal); the paper never calls it LAD type I and states genetic testing was unavailable, so there are no variant rows and n_patients_reported (patients with an ITGB2 variant) is null. A previously published person (Moutsopoulos et al, ref 19, 'a patient with LAD-1' with oral inflammatory lesions treated with ustekinumab) is included as 'ref 19 patient' because a feature is given; it has no other individual-level facts. The parents (paternal cousins) are neither tested nor affected and get no rows. Age: the patient was 24 at presentation, when the LAD work-up and diagnosis were made, recorded as age at diagnosis; the last evaluation was a 4-year follow-up with no age stated, so age at last evaluation is not reported. Vital status not stated explicitly. Table 1 '-ve' cells for HBsAg, HIV and HCV were not recorded as excluded because the paper's legend does not define '-ve'; differential counts within reference ranges were not recorded because the paper does not call them normal. Elevated ESR is recorded from Table 1 (48 vs reference 0-22); the text does not call it elevated. 'Head and neck examination was within normal limits' excludes nothing more specific and was not recorded. Uneventful healing after extraction/surgery was recorded as a narrow excluded feature; checklist 'impaired wound healing' left not reported (narrow vs broad). Candida albicans in crevicular fluid culture is not stated to be a fungal infection, so checklist 'fungal infections' is not reported. Patient's perspective section not used for additional features. No contradictions found.

span: a decision to extract all remaining teeth was made
the patient was given a 1-week course of antibiotics (amoxicillin and clavulanic acid 625 mg P.O three times daily). An immediate denture was also inserted

the patient underwent bilateral maxillary sinus lift (lateral window) together with onlay bone augmentation of the maxillary alveolar ridge using autogenous bone harvested from the iliac crest. Four dental implants (XiVES-Germany) were also placed in the anterior mandibular area

two new implants (XiVES-Germany) with the same length but with larger diameter were placed at the same site to replace the failed mandibular implants, and six implants were placed in the maxilla (XiVES-Germany)
an upper and lower hybrid prostheses were constructed

disease_label_as_stated.span: Therefore, a diagnosis of mild LAD was made.

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: clinical features and persistently elevated WBC, confirmed by flow cytometry showing decreased CD18 expression (82.6% of normal) with normal CD11; genetic testing unavailable
span: The severe and generalised periodontitis together with a history of recurrent skin infections and a persistently elevated WBC suggested that the patient might have LAD.
To confirm the diagnosis, neutrophils and lymphocytes were examined using flow cytometry.
revealed a decreased expression of CD18 (82.6% of normal) and normal expression of CD11
Genetic testing for mutations in CD18 therefore might be necessary to confirm the diagnosis of LAD and to reveal the underlying genetic events, but unfortunately this was unavailable in our case.
